title: yaml.load() without SafeLoader on bus messages — arbitrary object instantiation possible
detail: `handle()` calls `yaml.load(message.body)` at line 17 without a Loader argument. Messages are received from the `aurora.telemetry.tenant` bus topic, which may accept input from tenant systems outside the service's trust boundary. PyYAML's default Loader supports `!!python/object/apply` and related tags, allowing an attacker who can publish to the topic to achieve arbitrary Python code execution in the consumer process. The fix is `yaml.safe_load()` or `yaml.load(..., Loader=yaml.SafeLoader)`. Confirmed by bandit B506 (MEDIUM/HIGH).
owaspCategory: A08 Software and Data Integrity Failures
